column6: Software abort is sampled while write/read descriptor READY is stably backpressured; reset restores the vendor engines without a force/release handshake.

These statements require a registered software abort to coincide exactly with an internal route or descriptor READY handshake; that phase is not deterministically controllable through the subsystem AXI-Lite interface, and forcing the handshake would verify a TB artifact rather than legal integration behavior.
A CH1 request with a deliberately invalid observed source exercises the defensive route-fault branch.
Disabled and busy starts are software-reachable independently on both channel register instances.
ST_VALIDATE lasts one clock and the subsystem AXI-Lite path cannot accept and commit a second abort write before the manager leaves this state.
rd_status_accept requires rd_desc_issued_reg, which becomes one only on the same edge that leaves ISSUE_RD_DESC.
Direct cmd_valid/cmd_ready coupling prevents a pending unaccepted command while both pending_cmd_accept and busy_i are low.
An idle software abort reaches the no-pending/no-busy fall-through branch.
A start while the selected channel is disabled reaches the disabled rejection branch.
A second start while the selected channel is active reaches the busy rejection branch.
The inner pending-command-only abort predicate is unreachable with the integrated direct manager handshake.
The enclosing write_valid predicate is false for every address that selects the case default item.
Correct CTRL address/data with WSTRB[0]=0 is protocol-reachable and side-effect free.
Queued AXI-Lite requests plus legal response backpressure reach VALID=1 READY=0.
A second CH1 start while only busy_i is asserted reaches this vector.
An idle software abort evaluates cmd_valid=0 pending=0 busy=0.
An idle software abort reaches busy=0 pending=0.
Queued AXI-Lite requests plus legal response backpressure reach VALID=1 READY=0.
AW-before-W at IRQ_ENABLE makes the held address match before write_valid.
The configured AXI-Lite crossbar never forwards local WVALID before AW has decoded a target.
The configured AXI-Lite crossbar never forwards local WVALID before AW has decoded a target.
write_commit is defined from both hold-valid bits and BVALID state, so these vectors contradict the RTL definition.
cmd_valid is generated only while the directly coupled manager is IDLE/cmd_ready; reset clears both.
write_commit or write_valid cannot be true when its prerequisite term is false.
pending_cmd_accept equals cmd_valid AND cmd_ready, so it cannot assert alone or while cmd_valid is zero.
Direct cmd_valid/cmd_ready coupling makes these pending/busy combinations temporally contradictory.
pending_cmd_accept cannot remain asserted with busy_i low at the software-visible abort commit edge.
The compound IRQ write predicate cannot be true when either write_valid or its selected-address prerequisite is false.
Every listed state has a synchronous reset exit to IDLE.
Software abort while write-descriptor READY is legally backpressured reaches COMPLETE.
rd_status_accept requires rd_desc_issued_reg, which becomes one only on the same edge that leaves ISSUE_RD_DESC; the direct completion predicate cannot be true on that edge.
